newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Rugby League board outlines peace talks.
newsitem.headline: Australian Rugby League board outlines peace talks.

text.p: The Australian Rugby League (ARL) board said on Wednesday it would pursue talks with Rupert Murdoch's Super League and television companies in an effort to establish a united national competition in 1998.

ARL chief executive Neil Whittaker said the board would aim for a two-tier system, with a "sustainable" number of teams in the national league, and a state-based competitions open to all existing ARL clubs.
However, if agreement could not be reached the ARL would go ahead with its Optus Cup competition in 1998, he said.
